summary: Improve lease, maintenance, and property-data workflows with practical PMS training. Review the five-day course outline and plan your team’s learning.
lede: Property management systems training covers how property and facilities teams organize lease, tenant, asset, and service-request information. Participants practise mapping lease and tenant-service workflows, checking record quality, building maintenance KPI views, and reviewing user access. Designed for property managers, facilities managers, administrators, and lease professionals, the course also addresses system integration requirements and reporting using process maps and Excel-based analysis.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who operate, administer, or improve property management systems and the workflows around them.
prerequisites: Expected preparation: working exposure to property, leasing, or facilities operations and basic spreadsheet familiarity. No coding or programming is required. Bring a laptop with access to Excel for spreadsheet-based exercises; no specific PMS vendor account or software installation is specified.
